description: Chat, mail and AI services in one window
notes: Nidi is installed with its own .msi into Program Files and updates itself from inside the app.
Windows asks once for administrator permission during install and uninstall.
pre_install: # Quit a running Nidi the normal way first, so its services save their logins
# (Discord keeps its token in memory until the page closes). The installer would
# otherwise close Nidi without that step. Needs Nidi 0.16.0+ for --quit.
Write-Host 'Quitting Nidi so its services can save their logins...'
if (Get-Process -Id $nidi.Id -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Host 'Nidi did not quit within 30 seconds; the installer will close it.' }
} else { Write-Host 'Quit Nidi from its tray icon before updating, or services may ask you to log in again.' }

script: if ($p.ExitCode -notin 0, 3010) { throw "Nidi installer failed with exit code $($p.ExitCode)" }

pre_uninstall: # Quit a running Nidi the normal way first, so its services save their logins
# (Discord keeps its token in memory until the page closes). The installer would
# otherwise close Nidi without that step. Needs Nidi 0.16.0+ for --quit.
Write-Host 'Quitting Nidi so its services can save their logins...'
if (Get-Process -Id $nidi.Id -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Host 'Nidi did not quit within 30 seconds; the installer will close it.' }
} else { Write-Host 'Quit Nidi from its tray icon before updating, or services may ask you to log in again.' }

script: if ($p.ExitCode -notin 0, 1605, 3010) { throw "Nidi uninstaller failed with exit code $($p.ExitCode)" }
} else { Write-Host 'Nidi is not installed in Windows, nothing to remove.' }
